name: Fitness_3
short_caption: The robot bows its head down briefly, then raises its arms overhead in a deep stretch or cheer before returning to its neutral pose.
movement_description: The robot starts by bringing its hands together in front of its waist while bowing its head deeply. It then raises its head, spreads its arms outward, and lifts both arms high above its head with curled fists, performing a deep upward stretch. Finally, the robot lowers its arms back down to its sides and returns to its neutral upright posture.
safety_notes: The robot raises both arms high above its head and sweeps them outward; ensure there are no low-hanging obstacles or nearby visitors within the arm's reach.
